@tool
extends SceneTree

func _init():
	var root_node = Node2D.new()
	root_node.name = "Player"

	var anim_player = AnimationPlayer.new()
	anim_player.name = "AnimationPlayer"
	root_node.add_child(anim_player)
	anim_player.owner = root_node

	var lib = AnimationLibrary.new()
	anim_player.add_animation_library("", lib)
	for anim_name in ["idle", "walk_north", "walk_south", "walk_east", "walk_west", "attack"]:
		var anim = Animation.new()
		anim.add_track(Animation.TYPE_VALUE)
		anim.track_set_path(0, NodePath("."))
		anim.track_insert_key(0, 0.0, 0.0)
		lib.add_animation(anim_name, anim)

	var anim_tree = AnimationTree.new()
	anim_tree.name = "AnimationTree"
	root_node.add_child(anim_tree)
	anim_tree.owner = root_node
	anim_tree.anim_player = anim_player.get_path()
	anim_tree.active = true

	var sm = AnimationNodeStateMachine.new()
	anim_tree.tree_root = sm

	var blend2d = AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D.new()
	var blend_configs = [
		["idle", Vector2(0, 0)],
		["walk_north", Vector2(0, -1)],
		["walk_south", Vector2(0, 1)],
		["walk_east", Vector2(1, 0)],
		["walk_west", Vector2(-1, 0)],
	]
	for cfg in blend_configs:
		var node = AnimationNodeAnimation.new()
		node.animation = cfg[0]
		blend2d.add_blend_point(node, cfg[1])
	sm.add_node("Locomotion", blend2d)

	var attack_node = AnimationNodeAnimation.new()
	attack_node.animation = "attack"
	sm.add_node("Attack", attack_node)

	var trans_loc_attack = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.new()
	# Transition on the "condition_attack" state-machine condition
	trans_loc_attack.advance_condition = "condition_attack"
	trans_loc_attack.advance_mode = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.ADVANCE_MODE_AUTO
	trans_loc_attack.switch_mode = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.SWITCH_MODE_IMMEDIATE
	sm.add_transition("Locomotion", "Attack", trans_loc_attack)

	var trans_attack_loc = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.new()
	# Transition back to Locomotion automatically at the end of the attack animation
	trans_attack_loc.advance_mode = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.ADVANCE_MODE_AUTO
	trans_attack_loc.switch_mode = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.SWITCH_MODE_AT_END
	sm.add_transition("Attack", "Locomotion", trans_attack_loc)

	var ctrl = Node.new()
	ctrl.name = "PlayerAnimController"
	ctrl.set_script(load("res://scripts/PlayerAnimController.gd"))
	root_node.add_child(ctrl)
	ctrl.owner = root_node

	var packed = PackedScene.new()
	packed.pack(root_node)
	ResourceSaver.save(packed, "res://scenes/Player.tscn")
	print("OK")
	quit()

extends Node

func set_move_input(input_vec: Vector2) -> void:
	# Set the blend position for the Locomotion blend space
	$AnimationTree.set("parameters/Locomotion/blend_position", input_vec)

func trigger_attack() -> void:
	# Enable the transition condition and travel to the Attack state.
	# The Locomotion -> Attack transition advances on "condition_attack",
	# and the Attack -> Locomotion transition switches "AtEnd" automatically.
	$AnimationTree.set("parameters/conditions/condition_attack", true)
	$AnimationTree.get("parameters/playback").travel("Attack")
	# Reset the condition flag so that travel works again on the next attack.
	$AnimationTree.set("parameters/conditions/condition_attack", false)

func current_state() -> StringName:
	return $AnimationTree.get("parameters/playback").get_current_node()

@tool
extends SceneTree

func _init():
	var root_node = Node2D.new()
	root_node.name = "Player"

	var anim_player = AnimationPlayer.new()
	anim_player.name = "AnimationPlayer"
	root_node.add_child(anim_player)
	anim_player.owner = root_node

	var lib = AnimationLibrary.new()
	anim_player.add_animation_library("", lib)
	for anim_name in ["idle", "walk_north", "walk_south", "walk_east", "walk_west", "attack"]:
		var anim = Animation.new()
		anim.add_track(Animation.TYPE_VALUE)
		anim.track_set_path(0, NodePath("."))
		anim.track_insert_key(0, 0.0, 0.0)
		lib.add_animation(anim_name, anim)

	var anim_tree = AnimationTree.new()
	anim_tree.name = "AnimationTree"
	root_node.add_child(anim_tree)
	anim_tree.owner = root_node
	# AnimationPlayer and AnimationTree are sibling children of the Player root.
	anim_tree.anim_player = NodePath("../AnimationPlayer")
	anim_tree.active = true

	var sm = AnimationNodeStateMachine.new()
	anim_tree.tree_root = sm

	var blend2d = AnimationNodeBlendSpace2D.new()
	var blend_configs = [
		["idle", Vector2(0, 0)],
		["walk_north", Vector2(0, -1)],
		["walk_south", Vector2(0, 1)],
		["walk_east", Vector2(1, 0)],
		["walk_west", Vector2(-1, 0)],
	]
	for cfg in blend_configs:
		var node = AnimationNodeAnimation.new()
		node.animation = cfg[0]
		blend2d.add_blend_point(node, cfg[1])
	sm.add_node("Locomotion", blend2d)

	var attack_node = AnimationNodeAnimation.new()
	attack_node.animation = "attack"
	sm.add_node("Attack", attack_node)

	var trans_loc_attack = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.new()
	trans_loc_attack.advance_condition = "condition_attack"
	trans_loc_attack.advance_mode = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.ADVANCE_MODE_AUTO
	trans_loc_attack.switch_mode = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.SWITCH_MODE_IMMEDIATE
	sm.add_transition("Locomotion", "Attack", trans_loc_attack)

	var trans_attack_loc = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.new()
	trans_attack_loc.advance_mode = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.ADVANCE_MODE_AUTO
	trans_attack_loc.switch_mode = AnimationNodeStateMachineTransition.SWITCH_MODE_AT_END
	sm.add_transition("Attack", "Locomotion", trans_attack_loc)

	var ctrl = Node.new()
	ctrl.name = "PlayerAnimController"
	ctrl.set_script(load("res://scripts/PlayerAnimController.gd"))
	root_node.add_child(ctrl)
	ctrl.owner = root_node

	var packed = PackedScene.new()
	packed.pack(root_node)
	ResourceSaver.save(packed, "res://scenes/Player.tscn")
	print("OK")
	quit()
